title: Knight Reading Cursed Book
description: A kneeling knight in ornate armor with a glowing yellow face and red plume reads from a large open book emitting purple magical smoke and symbols including hearts and the word 'DESPAIR'. Broken swords lie on the snowy ground in a festive yet eerie forest with mummies and glowing orbs in the background.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene of a medieval knight in full armor with a large red plume kneeling in the snow, reading an ancient glowing book that emits purple magical smoke and displays hearts and the word DESPAIR, broken swords on the ground, eerie mummies and tentacles in the snowy Christmas forest with glowing lights and ornaments, atmospheric and mystical lighting, highly detailed digital art
